item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid maritime airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be rather warm during the day over the region. An upper-air disturbance will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong early next week. A cold front is expected to reach southern China midweek next week, the weather will become cool with rain over the region.
